Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ausparl 0.1.1

  • Added authors: Pat Leslie, Marija Taflaga, Kenneth Benoit, Rohan Alexander and Keith Dowding, alongside Guangnan Zhu. Pat Leslie is now the maintainer.
  • Tests pass with duckdb 2.x, which keeps one database instance per file: the raw test connection opens its own copy of the sample. db_connect() explains the error duckdb 2.x gives when another connection holds the file with different settings.
  • Added CITATION.cff and a suggested citation in the README.
  • The worked example in example/ shows how to connect: db_connect(sample = TRUE) for the bundled sample, or db_connect(path = ) for a full copy.
  • New vignette, vignette("database"): a guide to the tables, identifiers, turn types, speaker resolution, date-scoped context views and provenance of the Hansard database. It runs on the bundled sample database.
  • The package help page, ?ausparl, now gives an overview of the functions by task, the common arguments, the package options and the environment variables.
  • citation("ausparl") lists all authors and the pinned database version and its DOI.
  • Added a pkgdown configuration for a documentation website.

ausparl 0.1.0

  • First release: read-only query access to the Australian Hansard DuckDB database, with db_download() for the pinned database version (7.0.0-20261123), table getters, speech and turn queries, full-text search, date-scoped context joins, activity summaries, as_corpus() for quanteda and result_provenance().
